liveness.note: The lane commits its answer here. No answer, no timestamp, no marker — so a lane that stops producing stops moving this and becomes overdue. The stamp is asked_at, not fetched_at: this file records a question being put, not a source being read. Naming it here rather than renaming the field keeps ask-chatgpt.mjs's own vocabulary intact.
